name: Gas-averaged graviton propagator of a Poisson brane gas has ghosts (theorem)
target: Positivity of the Kallen-Lehmann representation of the averaged propagator of a Poisson gas of branes
result: Negative: E[1/(zF(z))] = exp(-phi(z))/z has no positive Kallen-Lehmann representation; for nu(dt) = lambda(t)dt/t the massive spectrum is ghosts alone exactly when lambda <= 1, and every average with a finite four-dimensional tadpole has states of both signs. Constructions: Campbell's formula for the Poisson average, Stieltjes and Bernstein-function representations, Plemelj boundary values.

notes.formal: Lean checks the residue signs, the sum rule, the elementary inequalities and the sign of the spectral density, not the whole theorem
notes.human: not yet refereed (Physical Review D package ready)
